Lemma
[Distance functions as Riemannian submersions]

Source: petersen:page-0114 ↗ def:pet-ch3-distance-function

1. ch3:3.2.8For $O$ open in a Riemannian manifold, $r:O o I\subset \mathbb R$ is a distance function if and only if it is a Riemannian submersion.
Proof

↗ lem:pet-ch3-distance-function-submersion

\sketch Since $Dr(v)=g( abla r,v)\partial _t$, the horizontal subspace $(\ker Dr)^\perp $ is spanned by $ abla r$. On $v=\alpha abla r$,

\[ |v|=|\alpha || abla r|,\qquad |Dr(v)|=|\alpha || abla r|^2. \]

Thus $Dr$ is an isometry on horizontal vectors exactly when $| abla r|=1$.

□
